measurement.name: Atlantic Equatorial Undercurrent
measurement.range_interpretation: One approximate regional background value; no numerical uncertainty, range, confidence interval, annual extrema or seasonal observations supplied.
measurement.geographic_scope: Atlantic eastward subsurface equatorial jet, called Lomonosov current; Brazil to Gulf of Guinea background description without paired boundary coordinates or a specified transverse section.
measurement.section_orientation: No reproducible transverse section endpoints supplied for the regional breadth description.
measurement.layer: Subsurface current background. Adjacent 150 m thickness and 50–125 m core depths do not define a fixed width measurement layer.
measurement.time_convention: 1988 French synthesis; no dated width occupation. Compilation years, dated example sections and transport occupations are separate supports.
measurement.boundary_rule: Approximate author-reported background width; no paired edges or boundary threshold directly resolved. Transport cutoff is not adopted as this width method.
measurement.source_citation: Y. Gouriou (1988), chapter III, section 3.3.2, printed p16, in Fonteneau and Marcille (eds.), FAO Fisheries Technical Paper 292 (French edition), ISBN 92-5-202652-5.
measurement.source_locator: Printed p16 / PDF page 31, section 3.3.2; title/copyright PDF pages 2–3; Figure 3.4 printed p18 / PDF page 33.
measurement.extraction_method: Approximate breadth transcribed from visually inspected institutional original; no contour, transport or coordinate digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original French volume confirms 200 km prose. Exact historical paired-boundary support remains unresolved. The later English OCR version and dated Voituriez sections are not independent 200 km width observations.
